text:
All 10 tests pass. The three surgical fixes in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — replaced `list(set(items))` (order-destroying) with a seen-set loop that preserves first-occurrence order, so `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]`.
2. **`partition`** — it returned `no, yes` (swapped); now returns `yes, no` so matches come first: `partition([1,2,3,4], x > 2)` → `([3, 4], [1, 2])`.
3. **`windows`** — the range stopped at `len(items) - k`, dropping the final window; changed to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)` so `windows([1,2,3,4], 2)` yields `[[1,2], [2,3], [3,4]]`.

Verified with pytest: 10 passed, 0 failed (the 7 previously-passing tests still pass).
